issues: Single-page document containing one numbered table row (№1) with a shared norm_doc (ГОСТ Р ИСО 17637) that spans a merged block of 6 object-name lines and 18 ОКПД2 codes / 15 ТН ВЭД codes, applied collectively to 10 indicator/range pairs (column 6/7) for visual weld inspection of playground/attraction/sports equipment. Because the scan has no cell gridlines aligning individual object lines to individual codes to individual indicators, object and code lists could not be reliably split per-indicator, so each of the 10 emitted rows repeats the full joined object text and full joined code lists per the brief's instruction for a numbered row with several indicators. No ТР ТС section heading appears anywhere on this page, so tr_section is null throughout. Handwritten registry number in the header ('Ро-591' approx.) and date stamp are partially cursive/illegible but are outside the table and not represented as rows.
